## What's new

From Kultr for the web, what makes sense on an iPhone:

- **Favourites can always be taken back.** A heart changes the moment you tap it, and tapping it again undoes it — on track rows and their menus, albums, artists and the full player. If the server refuses, the heart goes back and you are told why.
- **Plays are counted by how much of the track you heard,** measured from how far it moved on rather than from how often Kultr checked. Listening with the phone locked or Kultr in the background counts in full; seeking still does not count.
- **Install without a computer.** The guide now explains how to install Kultr on the iPhone alone, with LocalDevVPN, SideInstaller and SideStore — which also re-signs Kultr every week for you. It works start to finish on iOS 27; iOS 18 to 26 need a pairing file made on a computer once. [How](https://github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md#without-a-computer-sideinstaller-and-localdevvpn)
- **Change a server's password.** In Settings → your server, touch and hold a server and choose **Change password…**; the address, username and name are filled in for you.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
